mapper.insert: INSERT INTO t_message (from_id, to_id, content) VALUES (#{fromId}, #{toId}, #{content})
mapper.delete: DELETE FROM t_message WHERE from_id = #{userId} OR to_id = #{userId}
mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM t_message WHERE (from_id = #{userId1} AND to_id = #{userId2}) OR (from_id = #{userId2} AND to_id = #{userId1})
mapper.update: UPDATE t_message SET `read` = 1 WHERE to_id = #{toUserId} AND from_id = #{fromUserId} AND `read` = 0
mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM t_message WHERE to_id = #{userId} AND `read` = 0

SELECT m.* FROM t_message m INNER JOIN ( SELECT LEAST(from_id, to_id) AS u1, GREATEST(from_id, to_id) AS u2, MAX(create_time) AS max_time FROM t_message WHERE from_id = #{userId} OR to_id = #{userId} GROUP BY u1, u2 ) latest ON ((m.from_id = latest.u1 AND m.to_id = latest.u2) OR (m.from_id = latest.u2 AND m.to_id = latest.u1)) AND m.create_time = latest.max_time ORDER BY m.create_time DESC
